name: toolport
description: Connects EnConvo to Toolport, the local MCP hub: one gateway exposing every MCP server configured in the Toolport app through search, call, script, confirm and paging meta-tools.

hub_url.title: Toolport gateway URL
hub_url.description: MCP endpoint of your Toolport gateway. Use http://127.0.0.1:8766/mcp when Toolport runs on this Mac (default), or an https:// URL for a remote gateway.

api_token.title: Toolport API token
api_token.description: Bearer token issued by the Toolport app for its gateway.
